verdict.rationale: Undermind documents a deep literature review that plans its own searches, follows citations and authors, and stops only when new searches stop finding relevant papers. Community users confirm these jobs run for several minutes, so the long autonomous research job is evidenced. Its notifications, however, are alerts about newly published papers on monitored topics, an adjacent feature that does not notify you when a research job finishes. Missing for 10: documented notification when a job's result is ready, evidence that jobs keep running after the user leaves the session, any job-status or background-queue mechanism.
